action_items: Minor: `package-lock.json` shows as modified in git — request expected ONLY .gitignore and package.json to be dirty. Diff is small (removes a few `libc: [glibc|musl]` entries from optional rollup native binaries — regenerated by the local yarn install because the installed yarn/npm lockfile format is slightly older). Either (a) add package-lock.json to .gitignore (this project uses yarn.lock as SoT), (b) `git checkout -- package-lock.json` and let yarn.lock be authoritative, or (c) commit the regenerated lockfile. Non-blocking for Publish.

Optional/cosmetic: build warns about dynamic+static import mixing on src/services/{auth,individual,mutual}.service.js — dynamic import in verify-email.js/dashboard.js won't be code-split. Not a deployment blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: Deployment-wrapper design is sound: canonical Vite app untouched, /app/frontend symlink lets read-only supervisor `cd /app/frontend && yarn start` resolve, /app/backend is a minimal FastAPI stub, and vite.config.emergent.js applies dev-server overrides (host 0.0.0.0, port 3000, symlink-loop-safe watcher) without touching /app/vite.config.js.
Backend stub only exposes /api/ and /api/health — as intended per request; no business logic tested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deployment wrapper verified working. Backend is a stub — do NOT test business logic on /api. Frontend is a Vite app; supervisor runs `yarn start` from /app/frontend (symlink to /app) which invokes vite --config vite.config.emergent.js. External URL: https://c162a380-3c3e-435f-a58b-7b9afaeeab11.preview.emergentagent.com. If future changes add business APIs, move them from the stub into a proper module and add tests here.
rca of the issue: package-lock.json dirty state: `yarn install` in this container regenerated npm's package-lock and stripped `libc` fields from a few @rollup/rollup-linux-*-gnueabihf / musleabihf optional entries (newer npm schema). Since the project's canonical package manager is yarn (yarn.lock present), package-lock.json should either be git-ignored or removed from the repo.
